description: This file defines classes and objects related to managing Common Table Expression (CTE) scopes and resolution within Spark SQL's logical plan analysis. It includes CteScope for scope management, CteRegistry for stack-based scope handling, and logic for placing WithCTE operators in query plans.

classes.name: CteScope
classes.description: Manages visibility and known CTE definitions within a scope, handling placement of WithCTE operators and CTE registration.

classes.name: CteRegistry
classes.description: Maintains a stack of CteScope instances and provides methods for scope management and CTE name resolution.

methods.name: tryPutWithCTE
methods.description: Attempts to place a WithCTE operator on top of a resolved operator if conditions are met.

methods.name: registerCte
methods.description: Registers a new CTE definition in the current scope.

methods.name: getCte
methods.description: Retrieves a visible CTE definition by name.

methods.name: mergeChildScope
methods.description: Merges CTE definitions from a child scope into the current scope.

methods.name: isSuitableOperatorForWithCTE
methods.description: Determines if an operator is suitable for placing a WithCTE operator on top.

methods.name: currentScope
methods.description: Returns the current CteScope from the stack.

methods.name: pushScope
methods.description: Pushes a new CteScope onto the stack.

methods.name: popScope
methods.description: Pops the top CteScope from the stack and merges its state.

methods.name: resolveCteName
methods.description: Resolves a CTE name to its definition, considering scope opacity.

methods.name: isSuitableMultiChildOperatorForWithCTE
methods.description: Checks if a logical plan is a multi-child operator with multiple UnresolvedWith subtrees.

methods.name: hasSuitableOperatorForWithCTEInSubtree
methods.description: Checks if a logical plan contains an UnresolvedWith pattern in its subtree.
